fields.statement: QA at 4ed003163: ran .github/scripts/ci-changes.sh by hand in scratch git repos: code=true for code since base with no green; code=false for a .rhiza/-only commit after green, for an Actions-style merge-commit HEAD whose PR side added only .rhiza/ since green, and for a merge of main bringing only .rhiza/; code=true for a merge of main bringing code, a bogus green sha, a green that is not an ancestor (rebase), and a path with a space. Ran ci.yml's green-commit lookup (gh api pulls/N/commits + check-runs named check) read-only against real PRs 509 and 510: it picked each PR's newest earlier commit whose check succeeded. go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/... passes; bash -n clean; a built rhiza check passes from a clean detached worktree of HEAD.

QA at 4ed003163: read docs/ci-since-last-green.md and its README link; the recipe's rule matches the script's behaviour exercised by hand (no green, non-ancestor green, .rhiza/-only diff vs code diff), its aggregate job ci-passed does not clash with the check job rhiza ci install writes, and its green test requires every check run of that name to succeed. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Docs|CI' passes.
